question: Which lords govern the lower ranges of the path according to the Mahikshottara?
premises: The Mahikshottara teaches the lords of the path.
Brahma governs from Ananta up to Pradhana.
Vishnu governs from Purusha up to Kala.
inference: The lower ranges of the path are apportioned among specific cosmic lords.
plain_english: In the revered Mahikshottara, the teacher declared these lords of the path: Brahma rules from Ananta up to Pradhana, and Vishnu from Purusha up to Kala.
